Novi Strilyshcha Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. In Novi Strilyshcha, an organization called 'Reshima leumit,' which included both Zionists and Stratin Hasids, allowed the Zionist movement to take over community leadership — a notable instance of political coalition-building between these two currents. Belz Hasidism, documented at several other sites in this collection, became influential here from the mid-19th century. In early August 1942, the entire Jewish community, 1,252 people, was deported to Bibrka; those not executed there were sent on to the Bełżec death camp.
